passages.text: Early in the morning Jerubbaal (that is, Gideon) and all the men with him camped beside the spring of Harod. And the camp of Midian was north of them in the valley near the hill of Moreh.
passages.sermon:
Gideon was also called Jerubbaal.
Gideon led a group of men.
Gideon and all the men with him got up early in the morning.
They camped beside the spring of Harod.
The Midianites had a camp.
The camp of Midian was north of Gideon and his men.
The Midianite camp was in the valley.
The camp was near the hill of Moreh.
passages.original: וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֨ם יְרֻבַּ֜עַל ה֣וּא גִדְע֗וֹן וְכָל־ הָעָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֔וֹ וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ עַל־ עֵ֣ין חֲרֹ֑ד וּמַחֲנֵ֤ה מִדְיָן֙ הָיָה־ ל֣וֹ מִצָּפ֔וֹן מִגִּבְעַ֥ת הַמּוֹרֶ֖ה בָּעֵֽמֶק׃

passages.text: Then the LORD said to Gideon, “You have too many people for Me to deliver Midian into their hands, lest Israel glorify themselves over Me, saying, ‘My own hand has saved me.’
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Gideon.
The LORD is God.
Gideon was the leader of Israel’s army.
The LORD said, “You have too many people with you.”
The LORD said, “I will not give Midian into their hands with so many people.”
The LORD said, “If I do, Israel might boast against Me.”
The LORD said, “Israel might say, ‘My own hand has saved me.’”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ גִּדְע֔וֹן רַ֗ב הָעָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתָּ֔ךְ מִתִּתִּ֥י אֶת־ מִדְיָ֖ן בְּיָדָ֑ם פֶּן־ יִתְפָּאֵ֨ר עָלַ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יָדִ֖י הוֹשִׁ֥יעָה לִּֽי׃

passages.text: Now, therefore, proclaim in the hearing of the people: ‘Whoever is fearful and trembling may turn back and leave Mount Gilead.’ ” So twenty-two thousand of them turned back, but ten thousand remained.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Gideon.
Gideon was the leader of Israel’s army.
The LORD told Gideon to speak to the people.
Gideon must say these words to the people.
He must say, “Whoever is afraid may leave.
Whoever is trembling may turn back.
You may leave Mount Gilead.”
Twenty-two thousand men left the army.
Ten thousand men stayed with Gideon.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה קְרָ֨א נָ֜א בְּאָזְנֵ֤י הָעָם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר מִֽי־ יָרֵ֣א וְחָרֵ֔ד יָשֹׁ֥ב וְיִצְפֹּ֖ר מֵהַ֣ר הַגִּלְעָ֑ד וַיָּ֣שָׁב מִן־ הָעָ֗ם עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וּשְׁנַ֙יִם֙ אֶ֔לֶף וַעֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אֲלָפִ֖ים נִשְׁאָֽרוּ׃ס

passages.text: Then the LORD said to Gideon, “There are still too many people. Take them down to the water, and I will sift them for you there. If I say to you, ‘This one shall go with you,’ he shall go. But if I say, ‘This one shall not go with you,’ he shall not go.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Gideon.
The LORD said there were still too many people with Gideon.
The LORD told Gideon to take the people down to the water.
The LORD said He would test the people for Gideon at the water.
The LORD said, “If I tell you, ‘This one will go with you,’ that man will go with you.”
The LORD also said, “If I tell you, ‘This one will not go with you,’ that man will not go with you.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ גִּדְע֗וֹן עוֹד֮ הָעָ֣ם רָב֒ הוֹרֵ֤ד אוֹתָם֙ אֶל־ הַמַּ֔יִם וְאֶצְרְפֶ֥נּוּ לְךָ֖ שָׁ֑ם וְהָיָ֡ה אֲשֶׁר֩ אֹמַ֨ר אֵלֶ֜יךָ זֶ֣ה׀ יֵלֵ֣ךְ אִתָּ֗ךְ ה֚וּא יֵלֵ֣ךְ אִתָּ֔ךְ וְכֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁר־ אֹמַ֜ר אֵלֶ֗יךָ זֶ֚ה לֹא־ יֵלֵ֣ךְ עִמָּ֔ךְ ה֖וּא לֹ֥א יֵלֵֽךְ׃

passages.text: So Gideon brought the people down to the water, and the LORD said to him, “Separate those who lap the water with their tongues like a dog from those who kneel to drink.”
passages.sermon:
Gideon led the people down to the water.
The LORD spoke to Gideon.
The LORD gave Gideon instructions.
The LORD said, "Some men will drink water by lapping it with their tongues like a dog."
The LORD said, "Separate these men from the others."
The LORD said, "Other men will kneel on their knees to drink."
The LORD told Gideon to keep these groups apart.
passages.original: וַיּ֥וֹרֶד אֶת־ הָעָ֖ם אֶל־ הַמָּ֑יִםס וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ גִּדְע֗וֹן כֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־ יָלֹק֩ בִּלְשׁוֹנ֨וֹ מִן־ הַמַּ֜יִם כַּאֲשֶׁ֧ר יָלֹ֣ק הַכֶּ֗לֶב תַּצִּ֤יג אוֹתוֹ֙ לְבָ֔ד וְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ יִכְרַ֥ע עַל־ בִּרְכָּ֖יו לִשְׁתּֽוֹת׃

passages.text: And the number of those who lapped the water with their hands to their mouths was three hundred men; all the others knelt to drink.
passages.sermon: Gideon led the people to the water.\r\nThree hundred men lapped water with their hands to their mouths.\r\nAll the other men knelt on their knees to drink water.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י מִסְפַּ֞ר הַֽמֲלַקְקִ֤ים בְּיָדָם֙ אֶל־ פִּיהֶ֔ם שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת אִ֑ישׁ וְכֹל֙ יֶ֣תֶר הָעָ֔ם כָּרְע֥וּ עַל־ בִּרְכֵיהֶ֖ם לִשְׁתּ֥וֹת מָֽיִם׃ס

passages.text: Then the LORD said to Gideon, “With the three hundred men who lapped the water I will save you and deliver the Midianites into your hand. But all the others are to go home.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Gideon.
The LORD chose three hundred men.
These men lapped water with their tongues.
The LORD said He would save Israel with these three hundred men.
The LORD said He would give Midian into Gideon's hand.
The LORD told Gideon to send all the other people home.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ גִּדְע֗וֹן בִּשְׁלֹשׁ֩ מֵא֨וֹת הָאִ֤ישׁ הַֽמֲלַקְקִים֙ אוֹשִׁ֣יעַ אֶתְכֶ֔ם וְנָתַתִּ֥י אֶת־ מִדְיָ֖ן בְּיָדֶ֑ךָ וְכָל־ הָעָ֔ם יֵלְכ֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ לִמְקֹמֽוֹ׃

passages.text: So Gideon sent the rest of the Israelites to their tents but kept the three hundred men, who took charge of the provisions and rams’ horns of the others. And the camp of Midian lay below him in the valley.
passages.sermon:
Gideon was the leader of the Israelites.
Gideon sent all the other Israelites to their tents.
Gideon kept only three hundred men with him.
These three hundred men took the provisions of the people.
These three hundred men also took the rams’ horns of the people.
The camp of Midian was in the valley below Gideon.
passages.original: וַיִּקְח֣וּ אֶת־ צֵדָה֩ הָעָ֨ם בְּיָדָ֜ם וְאֵ֣ת שׁוֹפְרֹֽתֵיהֶ֗ם וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־ אִ֤ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ שִׁלַּח֙ אִ֣ישׁ לְאֹֽהָלָ֔יו וּבִשְׁלֹשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת הָאִ֖ישׁ הֶֽחֱזִ֑יק וּמַחֲנֵ֣ה מִדְיָ֔ן הָ֥יָה ל֖וֹ מִתַּ֥חַת בָּעֵֽמֶק׃פ

passages.text: That night the LORD said to Gideon, “Get up and go down against the camp, for I have delivered it into your hand.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Gideon that night.
The LORD said, “Get up.
Go down to the camp.
I have given the camp into your hand.”
passages.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ בַּלַּ֣יְלָה הַה֔וּא וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ יְהוָ֔ה ק֖וּם רֵ֣ד בַּֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה כִּ֥י נְתַתִּ֖יו בְּיָדֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: But if you are afraid to do so, then go down to the camp with your servant Purah and listen to what they are saying. Then your hands will be strengthened to attack the camp.” So he went with Purah his servant to the outposts where armed men were guarding the camp.
passages.sermon:
Gideon was a leader of Israel.
God spoke to Gideon.
God said, “If you are afraid to go down to the camp, take your servant Purah with you.
Go down together to the camp.
Listen to what the people in the camp are saying.
After you hear them, you will be encouraged.
Then you will be able to attack the camp.”
Gideon went down to the camp with his servant Purah.
They reached the edge of the camp where armed men were guarding.
passages.original: וְאִם־ יָרֵ֥א אַתָּ֖ה לָרֶ֑דֶת רֵ֥ד אַתָּ֛ה וּפֻרָ֥ה נַעַרְךָ֖ אֶל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃ וְשָֽׁמַעְתָּ֙ מַה־ יְדַבֵּ֔רוּ וְאַחַר֙ תֶּחֱזַ֣קְנָה יָדֶ֔יךָ וְיָרַדְתָּ֖ בַּֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וַיֵּ֤רֶד הוּא֙ וּפֻרָ֣ה נַעֲר֔וֹ אֶל־ קְצֵ֥ה הַחֲמֻשִׁ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃

passages.text: Now the Midianites, Amalekites, and all the other people of the east had settled in the valley like a swarm of locusts, and their camels were as countless as the sand on the seashore.
passages.sermon:
The Midianites, the Amalekites, and all the people from the east gathered in the valley.
They filled the valley.
They were as many as a swarm of locusts.
Their camels were too many to count.
Their camels were as countless as the sand on the seashore.
passages.original: וּמִדְיָ֨ן וַעֲמָלֵ֤ק וְכָל־ בְּנֵי־ קֶ֙דֶם֙ נֹפְלִ֣ים בָּעֵ֔מֶק כָּאַרְבֶּ֖ה לָרֹ֑ב וְלִגְמַלֵּיהֶם֙ אֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֔ר כַּח֛וֹל שֶׁעַל־ שְׂפַ֥ת הַיָּ֖ם לָרֹֽב׃

passages.text: And as Gideon arrived, a man was telling his friend about a dream. “Behold, I had a dream,” he said, “and I saw a loaf of barley bread come tumbling into the Midianite camp. It struck the tent so hard that the tent overturned and collapsed.”
passages.sermon:
Gideon was a leader of Israel.
Gideon came near the camp of Midian.
A man stood in the camp.
This man spoke to his friend.
The man told his friend about a dream.
He said, “I had a dream.”
He said, “I saw a loaf of barley bread.”
The loaf of barley bread tumbled into the camp of Midian.
The loaf came to a tent.
The loaf struck the tent.
The tent fell down.
The tent turned upside down.
The tent collapsed.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֣א גִדְע֔וֹן וְהִ֨נֵּה־ אִ֔ישׁ מְסַפֵּ֥ר לְרֵעֵ֖הוּ חֲל֑וֹם וַיֹּ֜אמֶר הִנֵּ֧ה חֲל֣וֹם חָלַ֗מְתִּי וְהִנֵּ֨ה צְלוֹל לֶ֤חֶם שְׂעֹרִים֙ מִתְהַפֵּךְ֙ בְּמַחֲנֵ֣ה מִדְיָ֔ן וַיָּבֹ֣א עַד־ הָ֠אֹהֶל וַיַּכֵּ֧הוּ וַיִּפֹּ֛ל וַיַּהַפְכֵ֥הוּ לְמַ֖עְלָה וְנָפַ֥ל הָאֹֽהֶל׃

passages.text: His friend replied: “This is nothing less than the sword of Gideon son of Joash, the Israelite. God has delivered Midian and the whole camp into his hand.”
passages.sermon:
Gideon was an Israelite.
His father was Joash.
A man in the Midianite camp had a dream.
He told his friend about the dream.
His friend answered him.
He said, “This dream means the sword of Gideon, son of Joash, the Israelite.”
He said, “God has given Midian into Gideon’s hand.”
He said, “God has given the whole camp into Gideon’s hand.”
passages.original: וַיַּ֨עַן רֵעֵ֤הוּ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֵ֣ין זֹ֔את בִּלְתִּ֗י אִם־ חֶ֛רֶב גִּדְע֥וֹן בֶּן־ יוֹאָ֖שׁ אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל נָתַ֤ן הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ בְּיָד֔וֹ אֶת־ מִדְיָ֖ן וְאֶת־ כָּל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃פ

passages.text: When Gideon heard the dream and its interpretation, he bowed in worship. He returned to the camp of Israel and said, “Get up, for the LORD has delivered the camp of Midian into your hand.”
passages.sermon:
Gideon was a leader of Israel.
Gideon heard a man tell a dream.
Gideon also heard the meaning of the dream.
Gideon bowed down and worshiped God.
Gideon went back to the camp of Israel.
Gideon spoke to the men of Israel.
Gideon said, “Get up.”
Gideon said, “The LORD has given the camp of Midian into your hand.”
passages.original: וַיְהִי֩ כִשְׁמֹ֨עַ גִּדְע֜וֹן אֶת־ מִסְפַּ֧ר הַחֲל֛וֹם וְאֶת־ שִׁבְר֖וֹ וַיִּשְׁתָּ֑חוּ וַיָּ֙שָׁב֙ אֶל־ מַחֲנֵ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ק֔וּמוּ כִּֽי־ נָתַ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה בְּיֶדְכֶ֖ם אֶת־ מַחֲנֵ֥ה מִדְיָֽן׃

passages.text: And he divided the three hundred men into three companies and gave each man a ram’s horn in one hand and a large jar in the other, containing a torch.
passages.sermon:
Gideon was the leader of the Israelites.
He had three hundred men with him.
Gideon divided these three hundred men into three groups.
He gave each man a ram’s horn to hold in one hand.
He gave each man an empty jar to hold in the other hand.
Gideon put a torch inside each jar.
passages.original: וַיַּ֛חַץ אֶת־ שְׁלֹשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת הָאִ֖ישׁ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה רָאשִׁ֑ים וַיִּתֵּ֨ן שׁוֹפָר֤וֹת בְּיַד־ כֻּלָּם֙ וְכַדִּ֣ים רֵקִ֔ים וְלַפִּדִ֖ים בְּת֥וֹךְ הַכַּדִּֽים׃

passages.text: “Watch me and do as I do,” Gideon said. “When I come to the outskirts of the camp, do exactly as I do.
passages.sermon:
Gideon was the leader of the Israelites.
Gideon spoke to his men.
Gideon said, "Watch me."
Gideon said, "Do what I do."
Gideon said, "I will go to the edge of the enemy camp."
Gideon said, "When you see what I do, do the same thing."
Gideon told his men to follow his actions exactly.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם מִמֶּ֥נִּי תִרְא֖וּ וְכֵ֣ן תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ וְהִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֥י בָא֙ בִּקְצֵ֣ה הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְהָיָ֥ה כַאֲשֶׁר־ אֶעֱשֶׂ֖ה כֵּ֥ן תַּעֲשֽׂוּן׃

passages.text: When I and all who are with me blow our horns, then you are also to blow your horns from all around the camp and shout, ‘For the LORD and for Gideon!’ ”
passages.sermon:
Gideon spoke to his men.
Gideon led three hundred Israelite soldiers.
He said, "I will blow my horn."
All the men with me will blow their horns too.
When you hear us, you must also blow your horns.
You must stand all around the enemy camp.
After you blow your horns, you must shout.
Shout, 'For the LORD and for Gideon!'"
passages.original: וְתָקַעְתִּי֙ בַּשּׁוֹפָ֔ר אָנֹכִ֖י וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתִּ֑י וּתְקַעְתֶּ֨ם בַּשּׁוֹפָר֜וֹת גַּם־ אַתֶּ֗ם סְבִיבוֹת֙ כָּל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם לַיהוָ֥ה וּלְגִדְעֽוֹן׃פ

passages.text: Gideon and the hundred men with him reached the outskirts of the camp at the beginning of the middle watch, just after the changing of the guard. They blew their horns and broke the jars that were in their hands.
passages.sermon:
Gideon was a leader of Israel.
One hundred men went with Gideon.
Gideon and his men came to the edge of the enemy camp.
They arrived at the start of the middle watch.
The guards had just changed.
Gideon and his men blew their horns.
They broke the jars in their hands.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֣א גִ֠דְעוֹן וּמֵאָה־ אִ֨ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ אִתּ֜וֹ בִּקְצֵ֣ה הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֗ה רֹ֚אשׁ הָאַשְׁמֹ֣רֶת הַתִּֽיכוֹנָ֔ה אַ֛ךְ הָקֵ֥ם הֵקִ֖ימוּ אֶת־ הַשֹּֽׁמְרִ֑ים וַֽיִּתְקְעוּ֙ בַּשּׁ֣וֹפָר֔וֹת וְנָפ֥וֹץ הַכַּדִּ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּיָדָֽם׃

passages.text: The three companies blew their horns and shattered their jars. Holding the torches in their left hands and the horns in their right hands, they shouted, “A sword for the LORD and for Gideon!”
passages.sermon:
Gideon led three companies of men.
Each company blew their horns.
They shattered their jars.
They held torches in their left hands.
They held horns in their right hands.
They shouted, "A sword for the LORD and for Gideon!"
passages.original: וַֽ֠יִּתְקְעוּ שְׁלֹ֨שֶׁת הָרָאשִׁ֥ים בַּשּֽׁוֹפָרוֹת֮ וַיִּשְׁבְּר֣וּ הַכַּדִּים֒ וַיַּחֲזִ֤יקוּ בְיַד־ שְׂמאוֹלָם֙ בַּלַּפִּדִ֔ים וּבְיַ֨ד־ יְמִינָ֔ם הַשּׁוֹפָר֖וֹת לִתְק֑וֹעַ וַֽיִּקְרְא֔וּ חֶ֥רֶב לַֽיהוָ֖ה וּלְגִדְעֽוֹן׃

passages.text: Each Israelite took his position around the camp, and the entire Midianite army fled, crying out as they ran.
passages.sermon:
Each Israelite stood in his place.
They surrounded the camp.
The Midianite army ran away.
The Midianites shouted as they fled.
The Midianites escaped in fear.
passages.original: וַיַּֽעַמְדוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ תַּחְתָּ֔יו סָבִ֖יב לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וַיָּ֧רָץ כָּל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֛ה וַיָּרִ֖יעוּ וַיָּנִיסוּ׃

passages.text: And when the three hundred rams’ horns sounded, the LORD set all the men in the camp against one another with their swords. The army fled to Beth-shittah toward Zererah as far as the border of Abel-meholah near Tabbath.
passages.sermon:
Gideon led three hundred men from Israel.
Each man blew a ram’s horn.
The LORD caused confusion in the enemy camp.
Every man in the camp turned his sword against his companion.
The whole enemy camp fought against itself.
The enemy army ran away.
They fled to Beth-shittah.
They ran toward Zererah.
They reached the border of Abel-meholah near Tabbath.
passages.original: וַֽיִּתְקְעוּ֮ שְׁלֹשׁ־ מֵא֣וֹת הַשּׁוֹפָרוֹת֒ וַיָּ֣שֶׂם יְהוָ֗ה אֵ֣ת חֶ֥רֶב אִ֛ישׁ בְּרֵעֵ֖הוּ וּבְכָל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וַיָּ֨נָס הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֜ה עַד־ בֵּ֤ית הַשִּׁטָּה֙ צְֽרֵרָ֔תָה עַ֛ד שְׂפַת־ אָבֵ֥ל מְחוֹלָ֖ה עַל־ טַבָּֽת׃

passages.text: Then the men of Israel were called out from Naphtali, Asher, and all Manasseh, and they pursued the Midianites.
passages.sermon: The men of Israel came from the tribes of Naphtali, Asher, and Manasseh.\r\nThey gathered together.\r\nThey pursued the Midianites.
passages.original: וַיִּצָּעֵ֧ק אִֽישׁ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל מִנַּפְתָּלִ֥י וּמִן־ אָשֵׁ֖ר וּמִן־ כָּל־ מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וַֽיִּרְדְּפ֖וּ אַחֲרֵ֥י מִדְיָֽן׃

passages.text: Gideon sent messengers throughout the hill country of Ephraim to say, “Come down against the Midianites and seize the waters of the Jordan ahead of them as far as Beth-barah.” So all the men of Ephraim were called out, and they captured the waters of the Jordan as far as Beth-barah.
passages.sermon:
Gideon was the leader of Israel at this time.
Gideon sent messengers through the hill country of Ephraim.
He told them, “Come down against the Midianites.”
He told them, “Seize the waters of the Jordan ahead of the Midianites.”
He told them, “Take control as far as Beth-barah.”
All the men of Ephraim responded to the call.
They captured the waters of the Jordan as far as Beth-barah.
passages.original: וּמַלְאָכִ֡ים שָׁלַ֣ח גִּדְעוֹן֩ בְּכָל־ הַ֨ר אֶפְרַ֜יִם לֵאמֹ֗ר רְד֞וּ לִקְרַ֤את מִדְיָן֙ וְלִכְד֤וּ לָהֶם֙ אֶת־ הַמַּ֔יִם עַ֛ד בֵּ֥ית בָּרָ֖ה וְאֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וַיִּצָּעֵ֞ק כָּל־ אִ֤ישׁ אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ וַיִּלְכְּד֣וּ אֶת־ הַמַּ֔יִם עַ֛ד בֵּ֥ית בָּרָ֖ה וְאֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃

passages.text: They also captured Oreb and Zeeb, the two princes of Midian; and they killed Oreb at the rock of Oreb and Zeeb at the winepress of Zeeb. So they pursued the Midianites and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon on the other side of the Jordan.
passages.sermon:
The men of Israel fought against the Midianites.
Oreb and Zeeb were two princes of Midian.
The men of Israel captured Oreb and Zeeb.
They killed Oreb at the rock called Oreb.
They killed Zeeb at the winepress called Zeeb.
The men of Israel continued to pursue the Midianites.
They brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon.
Gideon was on the other side of the Jordan River.
passages.original: וַֽיִּלְכְּד֡וּ שְׁנֵֽי־ שָׂרֵ֨י מִדְיָ֜ן אֶת־ עֹרֵ֣ב וְאֶת־ זְאֵ֗ב וַיַּהַרְג֨וּ אֶת־ עוֹרֵ֤ב בְּצוּר־ עוֹרֵב֙ וְאֶת־ זְאֵב֙ הָרְג֣וּ בְיֶֽקֶב־ זְאֵ֔ב וַֽיִּרְדְּפ֖וּ אֶל־ מִדְיָ֑ן וְרֹאשׁ־ עֹרֵ֣ב וּזְאֵ֔ב הֵבִ֙יאוּ֙ אֶל־ גִּדְע֔וֹן מֵעֵ֖בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
